settings.question: How do I know which iPad model I have?
settings.answer: Open Settings > General > About and check the model name. You can also compare your iPad with our model guide.

settings.question: What happens if I choose the wrong model?
settings.answer: Contact us as soon as possible. We will help confirm the correct fit before your order ships whenever we can.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Shipping times vary by destination. You will receive tracking details once your order is on the way.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, international shipping may be available depending on your location and checkout options.

settings.question: Can I return my order?
settings.answer: Returns are accepted according to our return policy. Items should be unused and returned with original packaging when required.

settings.question: What if my item arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Please contact support with your order number and photos of the damage so we can help resolve it quickly.

settings.question: Does the keyboard case support Apple Pencil?
settings.answer: Many NoxRev keyboard cases are designed with Apple Pencil storage or compatibility. Check the product details for your exact model.

settings.question: Does it need charging?
settings.answer: Yes, keyboard cases with Bluetooth or backlit keys need charging. Battery life depends on usage and lighting settings.
